title: God’s Plan Does Not Change
verse: He answered, “Have you not read that from the beginning the Creator ,
observation: In modern times, there are those who think of God’s Word as changing or adapting to the times. There are some who think that God’s Word develops with the cultures or with what they call “social progress.” However, this is not true. It is impossible to improve on what is already inerrant. If culture and God’s Word do not agree, it is culture that must bow its knee to the Creator of the world. This happens in every generation. One generation swings to the left and the other swings to the right. It is God’s Word that keeps everything tethered to the unchanging will of God.
application: Go to God’s Word, not the winds of culture, for daily life instruction.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always being solid and never changing.
